models.content:
# HiDream-O1 Storyboard Rules

- Preserve the selected scene order and one clear visual subject per keyframe.
- Ground each prompt in the scene contract's physical objects, environment, action, camera, and lighting.
- Do not create poster layouts, typography compositions, title cards, quote cards, UI screens, or social-media graphics.
- Prefer photographed, practical visual moments over symbolic diagrams or written explanations.

models.content:
# HiDream-O1 No Unwanted Text Rules

- Do not generate readable text, fake text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, UI, screens, captions, subtitles, watermarks, documents, charts, paper labels, or distorted letters.
- Use text-sparse visual composition and avoid any written-word focal point.
- Add negative prompt terms for readable text, typography, logos, labels, UI, screens, captions, subtitles, watermarks, documents, charts, poster, title card, quote card, headline, and social media graphic.
- Use plain unmarked surfaces for notebooks, mugs, packages, walls, screens, signs, and paper-like objects.
- Block any composition that depends on written words, centered headlines, text overlays, or poster-style graphic design.
